items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I never heard a man play on a G-string on a violin like Max Fink.

ctx.x: Was Max Fink hot like Oscar Marco or was he more straight?
No, Max Fink was straight. And Max Fink had the most scientific G-string solo on his violin than anybody you ever heard in your life. I never heard a man play on a G-string on a violin like Max Fink.
Did he play in the theater here like the Art of Fame? Yeah, he played at the Liberty Theater. He played at the Little Club, didn't he?
